newsitem.title: KENYA: Up to 35 people reported killed in boat tragedy.
newsitem.headline: Up to 35 people reported killed in boat tragedy.

text.p: Up to 35 people died after their boat capsized in Lake Victoria near the western Kenyan towns of Homa Bay and Asembo, newspapers reported on Friday.
The Daily Nation newspaper said that six people survived the disaster by clinging to pieces of wood, jerrycans and baskets loaded with fish. It said no bodies had been recovered yet.
The boat, which capsized on Wednesday, was also carrying bags of maize, the Daily Nation added.
The boat's owner, his wife and two children were passengers on the vessel and were drowned, the newspaper said.
"The 35 perished in the deep waters of the lake during high tides...," the Kenya Times newspaper said in a front-page story.
Boat disasters are frequent on Lake Victoria. In one of the worst disasters on the lake, hundreds of people were killed last year when the MV Bukoba capsized near the Tanzanian town of Mwanza.
